AD_MODULE.NAME: Etendo Encrypted Attachments
AD_MODULE.DESCRIPTION: Encrypted attachment storage with per-client envelope encryption (KEK/DEK + AES-256-GCM)
AD_MODULE.HELP: Provides an encrypted attachment method ("ENC") that integrates with Etendo's standard attachment upload/download flow. Files are encrypted on disk using per-client data encryption keys (DEK) wrapped with a master key (KEK) stored outside the database. Ensures cryptographic tenant isolation: a user of one client cannot decrypt files belonging to another client.
